name: grep
description: Search file contents; literal/regex auto-detected, git-aware. Smart-case ignores case for lowercase patterns. Files are ranked; matches stay in source order. Skips files >=256 KiB; use rg in bash.

path.description: Filter full repo-relative paths: directory prefix (src/), filename (main.ts), or glob (**/*.ts). Absolute, ~/ and ../ paths may search outside cwd.

exclude.description: Exclude using path syntax; comma/space-separated or array. Leading ! is ignored.

name: find
description: Search whole repo-relative paths by fuzzy terms or glob; multi-word terms are unordered AND. Explore concepts/features/symbols with this first, before ls/find/bash; use ls/read only for directory layout or no matches.
